text:
ravi: Customer kickoff: gov agency wants POC but Q asks: can control plane telemetry and logs be restricted to EU, and what about subprocessors?

claire: quick note: hosted allows inference + storage in eu regions; control plane defaults to us. For contractual EU-only control plane we need Private or an enterprise EU control-plane option.

ben: they also want BYOK with EU HSM. Private supports full BYOK+HSM. Dedicated can use customer KMS in their VPC but HSM attestation is PS.

olga: subprocessors: primary compute is aws-eu and gcp-eu. Some alerting/monitoring SaaS are US-based unless we run those on-customer infra. Will prepare redacted list.

ravi: they asked for a sample policy snippet to prove config. can we give one?

claire: snippet (YAML):

tenant_policy:
  tenant: gov-poc
  region_pin: [eu-west-1]
  cross_region_failover: false
  telemetry: eu-only
  allowed_subprocessors: [aws-eu, gcp-eu]
  kms: customer-byo-eu

ben: note: disabling failover reduces availability; requires signed SLA. pricing: Dedicated ~3-5x hosted + BYOK/HSM ~10% + one-off ~6k. Private EU control plane adds setup ~8k. Finance to confirm.

olga: legal-bot, please generate DPA + redacted subproc list for the customer.

legal-bot: DPA and subprocessor manifest request logged: DOC-4422.

ravi: next steps: 1) attach redacted subproc list and DPA (legal); 2) ops to confirm monitoring endpoints that need gating (ben); 3) finance to send pricing delta (claire).

ben: I'll run telemetry path matrix and report back by EOW.

ravi: thanks team, prepping reply to customer.
